purpose: Keep Tokai/MAD and Ka-go convoy-near ASW capability explicit and separate from fighter/anti-shipping OOB.

Tokai_MAD.branch_clock: Branch has MAD-capable trial/initial deployment in 1943 and radar+MAD integrated standard production in late-1943 to 1944H1; this is earlier/more mature than strict historical mass operationalization.
Tokai_MAD.historical_technology_guard: MAD is close datum localization, not wide-area submarine search. Search/detection must be generated by fixed-wing radar/visual/DF/convoy cueing first.

national_branch_planning_band_1944_02.derivation: Low/medium-confidence interpolation backward from authoritative 1944-04-30 branch state of 25-40 MAD-capable aircraft and 3-5 detachments; not an exact production ledger.

western_Indian_Ocean_detachment.cross_theater_debit: These aircraft are included inside the national branch total and unavailable to other priority ASW zones while assigned west.

event_gate: separate attack denial, weapon delivery, damage, mission kill and kill outputs

Ka_go_Ka1.branch_capability: The branch recognizes practical Ka-go/Akitsu-Maru-centered use from 1943, mainly short-range visual/radio/marker contact holding and handoff. Lightweight MAD remains trial-level in 1944.

local_Indian_Ocean_1944_02_19_22.reason: No dated branch-valid Akitsu Maru/Ka-go movement places the platform in the Indian Ocean event area in this window. Type existence is not converted into local presence.

Ka_go_Ka1.future_event_rule: If Akitsu Maru or another valid Ka-go platform is later posted to a convoy, rebuild the local load from the branch typical range (4-6 retaining amphibious function; 6-8 ASW emphasis; 8-10 only with strong specialization cost) and check deck/weather constraints.
Ka_go_Ka1.historical_anchor_guard: Historical shipboard Ka-1 ASW employment is clearly documented later in 1944; using it in February therefore requires explicit branch divergence plus dated local movement, not silent historical inheritance.

other_patrol_aircraft.rule: G4M/B5N/floatplanes or Army reconnaissance aircraft may assist search/ASW only when locally present and tasked. They are not counted as Tokai/MAD aircraft and do not receive the Tokai datum-maintenance performance automatically.
other_patrol_aircraft.no_double_count: If a 705/331/Army aircraft is tasked to ASW/search for a window, debit its strike/recon availability in the main air ledger.

submarine_adjudication_link.priority_lane_effect: Use the existing 1944Q1 20-30% attack-realization reduction only where a priority covered lane and actual local coverage are established; never stack it with the global reduction on the same event.
submarine_adjudication_link.ka_go_effect_in_this_window: none in Indian Ocean because local physical presence is zero

provenance.note: External history constrains technology/use; February force numbers are explicit branch interpolations and local-presence accounting.
